meta.tagline: Trusted roof repair and replacement in Austin
meta.insuranceText: Fully licensed and insured for residential and commercial work

seo.title: Summit Roofing Co. | Roof Repair & Replacement in Austin, TX
seo.description: Licensed Austin roofers for repair, replacement, and storm damage. Free inspections. Call for a quote today.

hero.headline: Austin's trusted roofing team
hero.subheadline: Repair, replacement, and storm damage — free inspections with honest quotes.

services.name: Roof Repair
services.shortDescription: Stop leaks fast with durable fixes.
services.longDescription: We locate the source of leaks, replace damaged shingles or flashing, and document everything for your records. Most repairs completed in one visit.

services.name: Roof Replacement
services.shortDescription: Full tear-off and install with premium materials.
services.longDescription: When repair is no longer cost-effective, we install architectural shingles or metal systems with proper ventilation and cleanup.

services.name: Storm Damage Inspection
services.shortDescription: Hail and wind assessments with insurance support.
services.longDescription: After severe weather we provide photo documentation and meet adjusters on site when needed.

services.name: Gutters & Drainage
services.shortDescription: Protect fascia and foundation from water.
services.longDescription: Seamless gutter install, guards, and downspout routing.

about.headline: Local roofers who show up on time
about.body: Summit Roofing has served Austin homeowners since 2008. We're a small crew — not a call center — so you talk directly to the people on your roof.

values.title: Honest assessments
values.description: We recommend repair when it makes sense — not a full replacement every time.

values.title: Clean job sites
values.description: Magnetic nail sweep and daily cleanup are standard.

values.title: Clear communication
values.description: You'll know the schedule, crew arrival window, and final price before work starts.

testimonials.author: Jennifer L.
testimonials.quote: They found the leak in an hour and fixed it the same day. Fair price and no pressure.

testimonials.author: Robert M.
testimonials.quote: Full roof replacement was on schedule. Crew was respectful and the yard was spotless.

faq.question: Do you offer free estimates?
faq.answer: Yes. We provide free on-site inspections and written quotes for repair and replacement.

faq.question: Do you work with homeowners insurance?
faq.answer: We document storm damage and can meet your adjuster on site. You maintain control of your claim.

faq.question: How long does a roof replacement take?
faq.answer: Most residential roofs are completed in 1–2 days weather permitting.

ctaBand.headline: Ready for a free roof inspection?
ctaBand.subheadline: Call or request a quote — we respond within one business day.

legal.privacySummary: We collect contact information you submit on forms to respond to your request. We do not sell your data.
legal.termsSummary: Estimates are valid for 30 days. Work is performed under a signed service agreement.
